boots-of-the-winding-path.summary: Bonus Action: teleport up to 15 ft to an unoccupied space you can see that you were in earlier this turn.

dazzling-weapon.summary: +1 to attack and damage rolls; Bonus Action to light or douse a 30 ft Bright, 30 ft Dim glow. 4 charges (1d4 back at dawn): Reaction after you're hit by an attack roll, spend 1 so the attacker makes a DC 15 CON save or is Blinded until the end of its next turn.

helm-of-awareness.summary: Advantage on Initiative rolls while you wear it.

manifold-tool.summary: Magic action: touch it to turn it into any Artisan's Tools; you are proficient with whatever form it takes.

mind-sharpener.summary: 4 charges (1d4 back at dawn). Reaction on a failed CON save to keep Concentration: spend 1 to succeed instead.

repeating-shot.summary: +1 to attack and damage on ranged attacks and no Loading; with no ammunition it makes a magic piece for each ranged attack, which vanishes once it hits or misses.

repulsion-shield.summary: +1 AC on top of the shield. 4 charges (1d4 back at dawn): Reaction when a creature no bigger than Large hits you with a melee attack from 5 ft or closer, spend 1 to push it up to 15 ft away.

returning-weapon.summary: +1 to attack and damage rolls; it flies back to your hand right after a ranged attack with it.

spell-refueling-ring.summary: Bonus Action: regain one spent spell slot of level 3 or lower. Once per dawn.
